segments.text: Your car breaks down on the motorway. So you call a tow truck.
It arrives sideways. With flashing lights. And two giant claws. The tow truck is a crab. What do you do?
Most drivers just point and shout: pick it up!
Big mistake. It picks it up by the roof. Snip! Now your car is a convertible.
And crabs only walk sideways. So it doesn't go to the garage. It takes you home, to the beach. And builds a sandcastle on you.
Here's how you do it properly.
Hazard lights on. Warning triangle out. Then wave hello.
It waves back. Clack, clack. That's crab for: no problem!
It lifts your car like a tray, and scuttles sideways. Right past the traffic jam.
Straight to the garage. Faster than any tow truck.
And as a tip, it keeps your warning triangle. Perfect party hat!
Next exam question: a goat eats your parking ticket. Follow, so you don't miss it.
